records.name: Nueces Center for Mental Health & Intellectual Disabilities (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.organization: Nueces Center for Mental Health & Intellectual Disabilities
records.description_en: The public mental health center for Nueces County. It offers crisis help, adult and youth mental health care, and services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
records.description_es: El centro público de salud mental del Condado de Nueces. Ofrece ayuda en crisis, atención de salud mental para adultos y jóvenes, y servicios para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Nueces County residents who need mental health, crisis, or disability services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del Condado de Nueces que necesitan servicios de salud mental, ayuda en crisis o servicios por discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: In a crisis, call the 24-hour crisis line at (888) 767-4493. For other services, call the main number at (361) 886-6900.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si está en crisis, llame a la línea de crisis de 24 horas al (888) 767-4493. Para otros servicios, llame al número principal: (361) 886-6900.
records.notes: 24-hour crisis line: (888) 767-4493. The old bhcnc.org (Behavioral Health Center of Nueces County) address redirects to this site. Hours not listed on the site.

records.name: Coastal Plains Integrated Health - Kleberg-Kenedy County Clinic
records.organization: Coastal Plains Integrated Health (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Public mental health clinic in Kingsville. It offers adult and youth mental health care, substance use help, disability (IDD) services, veteran services, and 24/7 crisis help.
records.description_es: Clínica pública de salud mental en Kingsville. Ofrece atención de salud mental para adultos y jóvenes, ayuda con el uso de sustancias, servicios por discapacidad intelectual (IDD), servicios para veteranos y ayuda en crisis las 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people living in Coastal Plains' 9-county area, including Kleberg County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el área de 9 condados de Coastal Plains, incluido el Condado de Kleberg.
records.how_to_apply: Call Coastal Plains at (361) 777-3991 or toll-free (888) 819-5312 and ask for the Kingsville (Kleberg-Kenedy) clinic. In a crisis, call the 24/7 crisis hotline at (800) 841-6467.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Coastal Plains al (361) 777-3991 o gratis al (888) 819-5312 y pida la clínica de Kingsville (Kleberg-Kenedy). Si está en crisis, llame a la línea de crisis 24/7 al (800) 841-6467.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.
records.cost: Fee schedule based on ability to pay (see provider fee schedule)
records.notes: 24/7 crisis hotline: (800) 841-6467. The clinic page lists only the agency main line (361) 777-3991 and toll-free (888) 819-5312; a direct clinic number could not be confirmed. Main office: 200 Marriott Drive, Portland, TX 78374.

records.name: Coastal Plains Integrated Health - San Patricio County Clinic (Taft)
records.organization: Coastal Plains Integrated Health (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Public mental health clinic in Taft for San Patricio County. It offers mental health care, substance use help, disability (IDD) services, and 24/7 crisis help.
records.description_es: Clínica pública de salud mental en Taft para el Condado de San Patricio. Ofrece atención de salud mental, ayuda con el uso de sustancias, servicios por discapacidad intelectual (IDD) y ayuda en crisis las 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people living in Coastal Plains' 9-county area, including San Patricio County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el área de 9 condados de Coastal Plains, incluido el Condado de San Patricio.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Taft clinic at (361) 528-4516 or the toll-free line (888) 819-5312. In a crisis, call the 24/7 crisis hotline at (800) 841-6467.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica de Taft al (361) 528-4516 o gratis al (888) 819-5312. Si está en crisis, llame a la línea de crisis 24/7 al (800) 841-6467.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.
records.cost: Fee schedule based on ability to pay (see provider fee schedule)
records.notes: 24/7 crisis hotline: (800) 841-6467. Agency main line (361) 777-3991; toll-free (888) 819-5312.

records.name: Gulf Bend Center (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Public mental health center in Victoria. It offers adult and youth mental health care, substance use treatment, disability (IDD) services, veteran services, and 24-hour crisis help.
records.description_es: Centro público de salud mental en Victoria. Ofrece atención de salud mental para adultos y jóvenes, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias, servicios por discapacidad intelectual (IDD), servicios para veteranos y ayuda en crisis las 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Jackson, Refugio, Lavaca and Victoria counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de los condados de Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Jackson, Refugio, Lavaca y Victoria.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 575-0611 or (800) 421-8825 for services. In a crisis, call the 24-hour line at (877) 723-3422.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (361) 575-0611 o al (800) 421-8825 para pedir servicios. Si está en crisis, llame a la línea de 24 horas al (877) 723-3422.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8 am-5 pm; open until 7 pm the 1st Thursday (Victoria)
records.notes: 24-hour crisis line: (877) SAFEGBC / (877) 723-3422; you can also call, text or chat 988. Also serves Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Jackson, Refugio and Lavaca counties.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend - Mission Plaza Career Center
records.description_en: Free job help center in Corpus Christi. Staff help with job searches, resumes, interview practice, career coaching, and training scholarships.
records.description_es: Centro gratuito de ayuda para encontrar trabajo en Corpus Christi. El personal le ayuda a buscar empleo, hacer su currículum, practicar entrevistas, recibir orientación profesional y conseguir becas de capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the Coastal Bend area. You do not have to be unemployed to use services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en el área de Coastal Bend. No necesita estar desempleado para usar los servicios.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the career center or call (361) 882-7491. Staff can also help by phone, text, and email.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de empleo o llame al (361) 882-7491. El personal también puede ayudarle por teléfono, mensaje de texto y correo electrónico.
records.notes: The board serves 11 counties including Nueces, San Patricio and Kleberg. Hours not listed on the site; call ahead.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend - Kingsville Career Center
records.description_en: Free job help center in Kingsville on the Coastal Bend College campus. It helps with job searches, resumes, and job training.
records.description_es: Centro gratuito de ayuda para encontrar trabajo en Kingsville, en el campus de Coastal Bend College. Le ayuda a buscar empleo, hacer su currículum y capacitarse para un trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the Kingsville and Kleberg County area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en Kingsville y el Condado de Kleberg.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the career center or call (361) 592-1006.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de empleo o llame al (361) 592-1006.
records.address: 1814 S. Brahma Blvd. (Coastal Bend College Campus)
records.notes: Hours not listed on the site; call ahead. The same phone number is also listed for the Falfurrias center.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend - Sinton Career Center
records.description_en: Free job help center in Sinton. It helps with job searches, resumes, and job training.
records.description_es: Centro gratuito de ayuda para encontrar trabajo en Sinton. Le ayuda a buscar empleo, hacer su currículum y capacitarse para un trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the San Patricio County area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en el Condado de San Patricio.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the career center or call (361) 364-3284 or (800) 727-4356.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de empleo o llame al (361) 364-3284 o al (800) 727-4356.
records.notes: Hours not listed on the site; call ahead.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Golden Crescent - Victoria Workforce Center
records.description_en: Free job help center in Victoria. It offers job search help, career exploration, wage information, and on-the-job training, with services for veterans, seniors, people with disabilities, and youth.
records.description_es: Centro gratuito de ayuda para encontrar trabajo en Victoria. Ofrece ayuda para buscar empleo, explorar carreras, información sobre salarios y capacitación en el trabajo, con servicios para veteranos, personas mayores, personas con discapacidades y jóvenes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the Golden Crescent area, including Victoria County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que buscan trabajo en el área de Golden Crescent, incluido el Condado de Victoria.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center or call (361) 578-0341.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro o llame al (361) 578-0341.
records.hours: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday
records.notes: Board office phone: (361) 576-5872. Mailing address: P.O. Box 2149, Victoria, TX 77901. The board serves 7 counties in the Golden Crescent area.

records.name: Child Care Financial Assistance - Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend
records.description_en: Helps low-income families pay for child care while parents work or go to school or training.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar el cuidado de niños mientras los padres trabajan, estudian o toman una capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in the 11-county Coastal Bend area with children under 13 (under 19 with a disability), income at or below 85% of State Median Income, and parents working or in school at least 25 hours a week (single parent) or 50 combined hours (two parents).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias en los 11 condados de Coastal Bend con niños menores de 13 años (menores de 19 si tienen una discapacidad), con ingresos iguales o menores al 85% del Ingreso Medio del Estado, y padres que trabajan o estudian al menos 25 horas por semana (un solo padre) o 50 horas entre los dos (dos padres).
documents_needed: Child's birth certificate or U.S. passport
Proof of income
Other items on the Child Care Document Checklist
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas Child Care Connection portal at childcare.twc.texas.gov, or call (361) 885-3010 for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en el portal Texas Child Care Connection (childcare.twc.texas.gov), o llame al (361) 885-3010 para recibir ayuda.
records.cost: Free or reduced cost; a parent share of cost may apply
records.notes: Income limit is 85% of State Median Income (for example, $7,670/month for a family of 4). Family assets may not exceed $1,000,000. Children must be U.S. citizens or legal immigrants and live with the applicant. Document checklist: https://childcare.workforcesolutionscb.org/Content/Child_Care_Document_Checklist_Eligibility.pdf. Service area: Aransas, Bee, Brooks, Duval, Jim Wells, Kenedy, Kleberg, Live Oak, Nueces, Refugio, San Patricio.

records.name: Child Care Assistance - Workforce Solutions Golden Crescent
records.description_en: Helps low-income families in the Golden Crescent area pay for child care while parents work, train, or go to school.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos en el área de Golden Crescent a pagar el cuidado de niños mientras los padres trabajan, se capacitan o estudian.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income parents who need child care to work, train, or go to school at least 25 hours a week (single parent) or 50 hours (two parents). Families on TANF or recently off TANF, teen parents, families with children with disabilities, and families experiencing homelessness may also qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Padres de bajos ingresos que necesitan cuidado de niños para trabajar, capacitarse o estudiar al menos 25 horas por semana (un solo padre) o 50 horas (dos padres). También pueden calificar familias que reciben TANF o que lo dejaron de recibir hace poco, padres adolescentes, familias con niños con discapacidades y familias sin hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 576-5872, email gcjobs@gcworkforce.org, or visit 1905 Leary Lane in Victoria. Enrollment forms are on the website.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (361) 576-5872, escriba a gcjobs@gcworkforce.org o visite 1905 Leary Lane en Victoria. Los formularios de inscripción están en el sitio web.
records.cost: Sliding fee (parent share of cost based on income)
records.notes: New applications are subject to a waiting list and priority of service. Parent share of cost is set by a sliding fee scale.

records.name: Head Start Birth to Five - Community Action Corporation of South Texas
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Free early learning and child care for young children from 6 weeks to 5 years old. Centers include Kingsville, Sinton, Mathis, Odem, Portland, Taft, Gregory, and Aransas Pass.
records.description_es: Educación temprana y cuidado gratis para niños desde las 6 semanas hasta los 5 años. Hay centros en Kingsville, Sinton, Mathis, Odem, Portland, Taft, Gregory y Aransas Pass.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For children 6 weeks to 5 years old in families that meet federal poverty guidelines. Children in foster care, homeless families, and families on TANF, SNAP, or SSI get priority.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños de 6 semanas a 5 años de familias que cumplen con las guías federales de pobreza. Tienen prioridad los niños en cuidado de crianza (foster), las familias sin hogar y las familias que reciben TANF, SNAP o SSI.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online with the Apply Now link on the program page, or call (361) 664-0145 or your local center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea con el enlace "Apply Now" en la página del programa, o llame al (361) 664-0145 o a su centro local.
records.notes: Income rules may be waived for children with disabilities who have an IEP or IFSP. Main office: 204 E First St., Alice, TX 78333. Portland Head Start: 518 Elm St, Portland, TX 78374, (361) 704-3165 (per headstart.gov locator).

records.name: Upbring Head Start / Early Head Start - Corpus Christi
records.organization: Lutheran Social Service of the South, Inc. (Upbring)
records.description_en: Free Head Start preschool and Early Head Start care at many centers across Corpus Christi, such as Los Pequenos, Stepping Stone, Cliff Maus, and Navarro.
records.description_es: Preescolar gratis de Head Start y cuidado de Early Head Start en muchos centros de Corpus Christi, como Los Pequeños, Stepping Stone, Cliff Maus y Navarro.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For young children in low-income families in Corpus Christi. Early Head Start serves infants and toddlers; Head Start serves preschoolers.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños pequeños de familias de bajos ingresos en Corpus Christi. Early Head Start atiende a bebés y niños pequeños; Head Start atiende a niños en edad preescolar.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 237-3041 to register.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (361) 237-3041 para inscribirse.
records.notes: Open centers per headstart.gov include Los Pequenos, 2801 Morris St (78405); Stepping Stone, 1625 Arlington Dr (78415); Cliff Maus, 1458 W Point Rd (78416); Navarro, 120 N 19th St (78408); La Armada, 3750 S Port Ave (78415). Gulfway Park is listed as closed. West Oso ISD Head Start (5350 Bear Ln) registers at (361) 806-5900.

records.name: Victoria County Head Start and Early Head Start
records.description_en: Free Head Start preschool and Early Head Start care in Victoria.
records.description_es: Preescolar gratis de Head Start y cuidado de Early Head Start en Victoria.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For young children in low-income families in Victoria County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños pequeños de familias de bajos ingresos en el Condado de Victoria.
records.how_to_apply: Call (830) 331-8908 to register.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (830) 331-8908 para inscribirse.
records.notes: Early Head Start center at 1309 E Red River St, (361) 661-3825. Head Start preschool: FW Gross Early Childhood Center, 1208 S Navarro St, Victoria, TX 77901, (361) 788-2847. Registration line: (830) 331-8908.

records.name: Free School Meals (Community Eligibility Provision) - Victoria ISD
records.organization: Victoria Independent School District Child Nutrition
records.description_en: All Victoria ISD students in PreK through 12th grade get free breakfast and lunch at school for the 2026-2027 school year.
records.description_es: Todos los estudiantes de Victoria ISD, desde PreK hasta 12.º grado, reciben desayuno y almuerzo gratis en la escuela durante el año escolar 2026-2027.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Any student enrolled at a Victoria ISD school. No meal application is needed.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier estudiante inscrito en una escuela de Victoria ISD. No necesita llenar una solicitud de comidas.
records.how_to_apply: No application needed. Families are asked to fill out an Income Survey form online at visd.net.
records.how_to_apply_es: No necesita solicitar. Se pide a las familias llenar una Encuesta de Ingresos (Income Survey) en línea en visd.net.
records.notes: Covers school year 2026-2027 under CEP. VISD also runs a Summer Meal Program.

records.name: Nueces Aid Healthcare Access
records.description_en: Helps Nueces County residents with low income get health care at low or no cost.
records.description_es: Ayuda a residentes del Condado de Nueces con bajos ingresos a recibir atención médica gratis o a bajo costo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Nueces County residents with household income at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines and countable resources under $5,571.37.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes del Condado de Nueces con ingresos del hogar iguales o menores al 150% de las Guías Federales de Pobreza y con recursos contables menores de $5,571.37.
documents_needed: Social Security card
Photo ID
Proof of income (pay stubs, tax returns, or benefit letters)
Bank/financial account statements
Vehicle descriptions and values
Proof of Nueces County residency (house payment receipt, rent receipt with lease, or utility bill with Statement of Residency form)
Property tax statement, if applicable
records.how_to_apply: Apply online, or get help at NCHD Enrollment Services, 600 Elizabeth St., Corpus Christi, or at a partner clinic. Call (361) 881-3000.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea, o pida ayuda en Enrollment Services del NCHD, 600 Elizabeth St., Corpus Christi, o en una clínica asociada. Llame al (361) 881-3000.
records.notes: Homestead, personal property and one vehicle are exempt from resources. Also enroll at Dr. Hector P. Garcia Memorial Family Health Center, 2606 Hospital Blvd. (361) 902-4855; CHRISTUS Trinity Clinic Robstown, 1038 Texas Yes Blvd (361) 861-9005; CHRISTUS Trinity Clinic Westside, 4617 Greenwood Rd (361) 814-8448. District administrative office: 555 N. Carancahua, (361) 808-3300.

records.name: San Patricio County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: County program that helps very low-income San Patricio County residents pay for health care.
records.description_es: Programa del condado que ayuda a residentes de San Patricio con ingresos muy bajos a pagar su atención médica.
records.eligibility_summary_en: San Patricio County residents with income at or below 21% of the federal poverty guidelines and resources under $2,000.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes del Condado de San Patricio con ingresos iguales o menores al 21% de las guías federales de pobreza y con recursos menores de $2,000.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the office to be screened. If you may qualify, you will get an application. A printable application is also online.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina para una evaluación. Si puede calificar, le darán una solicitud. También hay una solicitud para imprimir en línea.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 am-5:00 pm (closed 12:00-1:00 pm)
records.notes: Monthly outreach: Mathis, 1st Tuesday, 600 N Frio; Ingleside, 1st Thursday, 2681 San Angelo; Aransas Pass, 2nd Thursday, 1212 W Wheeler (all 9-11:30 am).

records.name: Kleberg County Indigent Health Care & Welfare
records.description_en: County office that handles indigent health care and welfare help for Kleberg County residents.
records.description_es: Oficina del condado que maneja la atención médica para personas de bajos recursos y la ayuda de asistencia social para residentes del Condado de Kleberg.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income Kleberg County residents. Call the office for income and resource rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del Condado de Kleberg con bajos ingresos. Llame a la oficina para conocer los límites de ingresos y recursos.
records.how_to_apply: Call the indigent health care line at (361) 595-8569 or the welfare line at (361) 595-8555.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de atención médica al (361) 595-8569 o a la línea de asistencia social al (361) 595-8555.
records.notes: Eligibility limits and hours are not posted on the county page (an 'Indigent Health Care Information' document is linked). The page also lists the Courthouse at 700 E Kleberg Ave.

records.name: Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District
records.organization: Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District
records.description_en: Public health office offering shots (immunizations), STI/HIV testing and prevention, tuberculosis services, WIC, and free developmental screenings for children up to age 5.
records.description_es: Oficina de salud pública que ofrece vacunas, pruebas y prevención de ETS/VIH, servicios de tuberculosis, WIC y evaluaciones del desarrollo gratis para niños hasta los 5 años.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves the Corpus Christi and Nueces County community. Call to ask about rules for each service.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a la comunidad de Corpus Christi y el Condado de Nueces. Llame para preguntar por los requisitos de cada servicio.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 826-7200 or visit the Horne Road office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (361) 826-7200 o visite la oficina en Horne Road.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. (closed 12:00-1:00 p.m.)

records.name: WIC Clinic - Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District
records.organization: Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition help, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC ofrece comida saludable, ayuda con la nutrición y apoyo para la lactancia a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant, breastfeeding, or postpartum women and children under 5 who meet income rules. You automatically meet the income rule if you get Medicaid, TANF, or SNAP. You must live in Texas; U.S. citizenship is not required.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas, que dan pecho o que dieron a luz hace poco, y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen las reglas de ingresos. Si recibe Medicaid, TANF o SNAP, cumple automáticamente con la regla de ingresos. Debe vivir en Texas; no necesita ser ciudadano de EE. UU.
records.how_to_apply: Start online at texaswic.org/apply, call (361) 826-1355, or apply in person at the clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Empiece en línea en texaswic.org/apply, llame al (361) 826-1355 o solicite en persona en la clínica.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8am-6pm (closed 12-1 pm); Friday 8 am-12 pm

records.name: Victoria County Public Health Department
records.description_en: Public health office offering shots (immunizations), STI testing, TB testing, WIC, and HIV/AIDS resources.
records.description_es: Oficina de salud pública que ofrece vacunas, pruebas de ETS, pruebas de tuberculosis, WIC y recursos sobre VIH/SIDA.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Serves Victoria County residents. Call to ask about rules for each service.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Atiende a residentes del Condado de Victoria. Llame para preguntar por los requisitos de cada servicio.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 578-6281 or visit the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (361) 578-6281 o visite la oficina.
records.hours: Monday through Thursday 8 am to noon, 1 pm to 5 pm (individual programs may vary)
records.notes: Closed weekends and county holidays. Individual programs may have different hours.

records.name: Victoria County WIC Program
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition help, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC ofrece comida saludable, ayuda con la nutrición y apoyo para la lactancia a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant, breastfeeding, or postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 who meet WIC income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas, que dan pecho o que dieron a luz hace poco, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen las reglas de ingresos de WIC.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 578-2884 or (800) 880-9427 to make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (361) 578-2884 o al (800) 880-9427 para hacer una cita.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8 am-noon, 12:30-5:30 pm; Fri 8 am-noon; 2nd and 4th Mondays 5:30-7 pm; 2nd and 4th Saturdays 8 am-noon
records.notes: Serves 6 counties: Calhoun, DeWitt, Jackson, Goliad, Lavaca and Victoria. Satellite clinics in Port Lavaca, Cuero, Goliad, Yoakum, Yorktown and Edna.

records.name: San Patricio County WIC Program
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and health referrals to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC ofrece comida saludable, educación sobre nutrición, apoyo para la lactancia y referencias de salud a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant, breastfeeding, and postpartum women, infants, and children who meet WIC income rules.

records.name: CEAP Utility Assistance - San Patricio County (CACOST Sinton office)
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric and gas bills through the Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP).
records.description_es: Ayuda a hogares de bajos ingresos a pagar las facturas de luz y gas por medio del Programa Integral de Asistencia de Energía (CEAP).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Households in San Patricio County with income at or below 150% of the federal poverty guidelines (for example, up to $23,940 a year for one person in 2026).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares en el Condado de San Patricio con ingresos iguales o menores al 150% de las guías federales de pobreza (por ejemplo, hasta $23,940 al año para una persona en 2026).

eligibility_rules.residency_required: San Patricio County (or other CACOST CEAP county)

documents_needed: Proof of citizenship or legal residency for each household member
30 days of pay stubs or 2025 benefit award letters
Front and back copies of current electric and gas bills with meter numbers
Notarized custody letter if claiming children who are not your biological children
records.how_to_apply: Applications are by appointment only. Request an appointment with the online form on the CEAP page, or call the Sinton office at (361) 364-0220.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solo se atiende con cita. Pida una cita con el formulario en línea de la página de CEAP, o llame a la oficina de Sinton al (361) 364-0220.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 9 a.m.-12 p.m. and 1 p.m.-4 p.m.
records.notes: The Sinton office also serves Bee County. CACOST CEAP does not cover Nueces, Kleberg, or Victoria counties.

records.name: CCRTA Reduced Fare Program (B-ID Card)
records.description_en: Half-price bus fares in Corpus Christi: $0.50 per ride and $17.50 for a 31-day pass.
records.description_es: Pasajes de autobús a mitad de precio en Corpus Christi: $0.50 por viaje y $17.50 por un pase de 31 días.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with disabilities (including disabled veterans), Medicare card holders, and technical/vocational college students. Seniors can show a state ID showing age 65+.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con discapacidades (incluidos veteranos con discapacidad), personas con tarjeta de Medicare y estudiantes de colegios técnicos o vocacionales. Las personas mayores pueden mostrar una identificación del estado que muestre que tienen 65 años o más.
documents_needed: Completed B-ID application (English or Spanish)
Medicare card, Disabled Veteran ID, Medicaid card, or state ID showing age 65+
records.how_to_apply: Show a valid ID when you board, or download the B-ID application, bring it to the Customer Service Center, and pick up your card once approved.
records.how_to_apply_es: Muestre una identificación válida al subir al autobús, o descargue la solicitud B-ID, llévela al Centro de Servicio al Cliente y recoja su tarjeta cuando la aprueben.
records.notes: Reduced 31-day passes are sold only at the Customer Service Center; single-ride reduced fares are paid when boarding. Customer Service phone line: Mon-Sat 8 am-5 pm. B-Line paratransit is also offered: https://www.ccrta.org/services/b-line
